caf5c7eb1f1b17.s:
Consider the following statements about ageing in India:
1. The share of people aged 60+ is projected to rise from 10% to about 20% by 2050.
2. NPS Vatsalya and NP-NCD were the schemes cited in the discussion on ageing.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf5c7eb1f1b17.x: The elderly share is projected to rise from 10% to about 20% by 2050. Statement 2 is wrong: the schemes cited were NPS Vatsalya and AB PM-JAY, not NP-NCD.

cad381c015f036.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the restructured PM SVANidhi scheme?
o: The first tranche was raised from ₹10,000 to ₹15,000.
Coverage was extended to census towns and peri-urban areas.
The third tranche was raised above ₹50,000.
The second tranche was raised from ₹20,000 to ₹25,000.
cad381c015f036.x: The third tranche remains ₹50,000, unchanged; only the first and second tranches were raised, to ₹15,000 and ₹25,000.

ca435458fcb1a8.s:
Consider the following statements about India's pharmaceutical sector:
1. It is projected to grow from $50 billion to $130 billion by 2030.
2. It supplies 40% of US generics.
3. It provides 40% of the world's vaccines.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca435458fcb1a8.x: The sector is projected to grow from $50 billion to $130 billion by 2030 and supplies 40% of US generics; it provides 50–60% (not 40%) of the world's vaccines.

ca899b8a0cae0d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about CBSE's two Class 10 board examinations from 2026–27?
o: The first examination is mandatory and held in mid-February.
The optional second examination is held in May, with results by June.
Students failing in 1–2 subjects can use the second examination.
Students failing in 3 subjects can use the second examination.
ca899b8a0cae0d.x: The compartment provision of the second examination applies only to students failing in 1–2 subjects, not 3.

caf6f46ae5e4be.s: In the NFSA ration-card verification exercise, which database–category pair is correctly matched?
caf6f46ae5e4be.x: MCA data identified company directors; the Income Tax Department identified taxpayers, MoRTH four-wheeler owners, and CBDT, CBIC and PM-Kisan data showed overlaps.

ca51aa4d1056a5.s: Which of the following pairs of immunisation milestones is correctly matched?
ca51aa4d1056a5.x: The MR campaign ran from 2017–2019. Tetanus elimination was in 2015, yaws-free status in 2016 and the Champion Award on 6 March 2024.

cab2f068971798.s: Which of the following pairs of immunisation programmes and years is correctly matched?
cab2f068971798.x: The Zero Dose Implementation Plan dates to 2024. EPI was 1974, UIP 1985 and Mission Indradhanush 2014.

ca3ed4926567a4.s: Which digital platforms are linked with India's immunisation efforts (June 2025)?
ca3ed4926567a4.x: Co-WIN and U-WIN are the immunisation platforms; DigiLocker relates to CBSE marksheets and NOTTO to transplant data.

cae0f384a68f96.s: The Jal Jeevan Mission (2019) originally aimed to provide tap water to every rural household by:
cae0f384a68f96.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission was launched in 2019 with the original target of tap water to every rural household by 2024.

caea8a92da2b14.s: Who released the Draft National Labour and Employment Policy — Shram Shakti Niti 2025 for public consultation?
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
caea8a92da2b14.x: The Union Labour Ministry released the draft Shram Shakti Niti 2025 for public consultation.

cad3ece12e6094.s: In the context of Building a Shikshit Bharat, the Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) has highlighted weakness in:
cad3ece12e6094.x: ASER has highlighted weak foundational literacy and numeracy; the 1.5% of GDP figure relates to recommended R&D spending, not ASER.

ca0bc575217b73.s: Which monitoring mechanisms are proposed under the Draft Shram Shakti Niti 2025?
o: One Nation Integrated Workforce and Annual National Labour Report to Parliament
Labour & Employment Policy Evaluation Index and District Employment Facilitation Cells
Labour & Employment Policy Evaluation Index and Annual National Labour Report to Parliament
Green Jobs Index and Annual National Labour Report to Parliament
ca0bc575217b73.x: The draft proposes the Labour & Employment Policy Evaluation Index (LPEI) and an Annual National Labour Report to Parliament for monitoring.

ca65386e077e4f.s: The corpus of the EPFO is approximately:
ca65386e077e4f.x: The EPFO corpus is more than ₹26 lakh crore (with 30 crore+ accounts, about 7 crore of them active).

cad0c74b464b92.s: Which State was declared India's first fully digitally literate State on 21 August 2025?
cad0c74b464b92.x: Kerala was declared India's first fully digitally literate State under the Digi Kerala programme, modelled on Digi Pullampara.

cae1c3b5422435.s:
Consider the following statements about Kerala's Digi Kerala programme:
1. It focused on computer-based literacy and excluded smartphone use.
2. It included trainees above 90 years of age.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae1c3b5422435.x: Digi Kerala focused on smartphone-based literacy, so 1 is wrong; 15,221 trainees were above 90 years of age.

cafb75e993087f.s: Which of the following Adi Vaani beta language–State pairs is correctly matched?
cafb75e993087f.x: The beta pairs are Santali–Odisha, Bhili–Madhya Pradesh, Mundari–Jharkhand and Gondi–Chhattisgarh.

ca5d5a329315b4.s:
Consider the following statements about Digi Pullampara:
1. It was started in 2021 in Pullampara panchayat of Thiruvananthapuram district.
2. Under it, 3,917 persons were trained while 3,300 were identified as digitally illiterate.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5d5a329315b4.x: Digi Pullampara began in 2021 in Thiruvananthapuram district. The figures in 2 are reversed: 3,917 were identified as digitally illiterate and 3,300 were trained.

ca60035d7c8fba.s: The beta version of Adi Vaani was developed by a consortium led by:
ca60035d7c8fba.x: An IIT Delhi-led consortium built Adi Vaani at about one-tenth the cost of commercial AI; BITS Pilani, IIIT Hyderabad and IIIT Nava Raipur were participants.

ca8c6b8d4a830c.s: As per WHO's 2023 guidance, stroke rehabilitation should ideally begin within:
ca8c6b8d4a830c.x: WHO's 2023 guidance says stroke rehabilitation should begin within 24–48 hours.

ca0e98a8e10978.s:
Consider the following statements about disability data collection in India:
1. Census 2011 used functional questions across 21 categories.
2. India has adopted the Washington Group–Short Set in all surveys.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0e98a8e10978.x: Both are wrong: Census 2011 used medical binary questions in 8 categories, and India has not adopted the Washington Group–Short Set in all surveys.

ca3bb8462b69e8.s: Which of the following disability-related measure–year pairs is correctly matched?
o: National Policy for Persons with Disabilities – 2006
ca3bb8462b69e8.x: The National Policy dates to 2006; the RCI Act is from 1992, the National Trust Act from 1999 and UNCRPD ratification from 2007.

ca64a37183bbbd.s: Which of the following was NOT among the listed initiatives for harnessing India's demographic dividend?
ca64a37183bbbd.x: The listed initiative was Stand-up India, not Digital India; PM-DAKSH and Atal Tinkering Labs were also on the list.

cad217696e20b5.s: Under Section 3.1(m) of the Forest Rights Act, 2006, Gutti Koya tribals displaced before the cut-off date are entitled to:
cad217696e20b5.x: Section 3.1(m) entitles tribals displaced before 13 December 2005 to alternative forest land.

cac664ba4b4e94.s:
Consider the following statements about ASHAs:
1. ASHA was introduced under the National Rural Health Mission in 2006.
2. ASHAs were classified as volunteers paid by incentives.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac664ba4b4e94.x: ASHA was introduced under NRHM in 2005, not 2006; ASHAs are classified as volunteers paid by incentives.

cafc51fa6ce6e3.s: Under Para 69(2) of the EPF Scheme, 1952, a member can make a full withdrawal after how long of unemployment?
cafc51fa6ce6e3.x: Para 69(2) permits full withdrawal after two months of unemployment; twelve months is the proposed waiting period for premature final settlement.

caf1db221d0098.s:
Consider the following statements about the HelpAge India study on intergenerational dynamics:
1. It surveyed 5,700 respondents in 10 cities.
2. It found that 78% of elders cited youth impatience as a concern.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf1db221d0098.x: The study covered 5,700 respondents in 10 cities. 71% (not 78%) of elders cited youth impatience; 78% of youth thought elders lacked digital interest.

ca46af1574bbe6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India's COVID vaccination began on 16 January 2021.
2. More than 220 crore doses had been administered by January 2023.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca46af1574bbe6.x: COVID vaccination in India began on 16 January 2021 and crossed 220 crore doses by January 2023.

cab11e6f60f27b.s: Which committee defined universal health care as care for all irrespective of ability to pay?
cab11e6f60f27b.x: The Bhore Committee (1946) defined universal health care as care for all, irrespective of ability to pay.

cac6cdb4f887e1.s: Which of the following pairs related to universal health care is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Public health spending target – 2.5% of GDP
cac6cdb4f887e1.x: The National Health Policy dates to 2017, not 2015. Canada and Thailand are UHC models and the public health spending target is 2.5% of GDP.

ca6193adb3fa64.s: CBSE's optional May Class 10 exam (from 2026–27) allows improvement in up to three subjects from among:
o: Science, Mathematics and Social Science only
Science, Mathematics, Social Science and two languages
Two languages and Social Science only
Science, Mathematics and two languages only
ca6193adb3fa64.x: Improvement in up to three subjects is allowed from among Science, Mathematics, Social Science and two languages.

cacee134e0a232.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Over one-half of ITI instructor posts were vacant.
2. Germany's dual system provides upper-secondary vocational education with paid apprenticeships.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacee134e0a232.x: The reported vacancy was over one-third of ITI instructor posts, not one-half; Germany's dual system combines upper-secondary VET with paid apprenticeships.

ca1f3507cc8d5e.s: The Hamas attack on Israel of 7 October 2023 involved:
ca1f3507cc8d5e.x: The 7 October 2023 attack involved 251 hostages and 1,219 people killed.

ca80c35681fc01.s:
Consider the following statements about the Gaza ceasefire:
1. Hamas agreed to disarm as part of the ceasefire arrangements.
2. The Israeli withdrawal remained incomplete.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca80c35681fc01.x: Hamas refused to disarm, so 1 is wrong; the incomplete Israeli withdrawal was one of the challenges facing the ceasefire.

cac5d25cdc54df.s:
Consider the following statements about India–UK ties:
1. The comprehensive India–UK trade deal was signed in June 2025.
2. The FTA had already completed implementation talks during the visit.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac5d25cdc54df.x: Both are wrong: the deal was signed in July 2025, and the FTA was still under implementation talks.

cad2afd5f6c62b.s: Nepal's Gen Z protest of 8 September 2025 began near:
o: The Mandala monument at Maitighar, Kathmandu
cad2afd5f6c62b.x: The protest began near the Mandala monument at Maitighar in Kathmandu before the Parliament complex was stormed.

caa555e3b0fa76.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Iran signed the NPT in 1970 and ratified it in 1968.
2. Article 2 of the UN Charter bars the use of force.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa555e3b0fa76.x: Iran signed the NPT in 1968 and ratified it in 1970, so 1 is wrong; Article 2 of the UN Charter bars the use of force.

ca958ed6516a5a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India does not formally recognise the Taliban regime.
2. During 1996–2001, India had no ties with the Taliban and backed the Northern Alliance.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca958ed6516a5a.x: Both are correct: India does not formally recognise the Taliban regime, and in 1996–2001 it backed the Northern Alliance.

ca50f2dc3b2b9a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The United States withdrew from Afghanistan in August 2020.
2. TTP stands for Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan and PTM for Pashtun Tahafuz Movement.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca50f2dc3b2b9a.x: The US withdrawal was in August 2021, not 2020; the expansions of TTP and PTM are correct.

cad2d1ff3f9341.s: The 15th India–Japan Annual Summit (2025), attended by PM Modi and PM Shigeru Ishiba, was held in:
cad2d1ff3f9341.x: The 15th India–Japan Annual Summit was held in Tokyo.

ca3cf4cd2340a3.s: Which of the following Indian State–Japanese prefecture partnerships is correctly matched?
ca3cf4cd2340a3.x: The partnerships are Andhra Pradesh–Toyama, Tamil Nadu–Ehime, Uttar Pradesh–Yamanashi and Gujarat–Shizuoka.

caf5c09025cbeb.s:
Consider the following statements about India–Japan ties:
1. 5,000 skilled and semi-skilled Indians were to be trained in Japan.
2. India runs a trade surplus with Japan.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf5c09025cbeb.x: Both are wrong: the training target was 50,000, and India runs a trade deficit with Japan.

ca94065bb43800.s: In the context of Nepal's Gen Z protests, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Ramesh Lekhak – Home Minister who resigned
Hami Nepal – Slogan targeted by the protesters
K.P. Sharma Oli – Home Minister who resigned
“Nepo babies” – Organisation that coordinated the protests
ca94065bb43800.x: Ramesh Lekhak was the Home Minister who resigned; Hami Nepal coordinated the protests, “nepo babies” was a slogan and Oli was the Prime Minister who resigned.

ca45c268997395.s: Who led the government of Bangladesh during the reported US military activity in Chittagong?
ca45c268997395.x: Bangladesh's government at the time was led by Muhammad Yunus.

ca17db01fc33c4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's response to Nepal's objection to Lipulekh trade?
o: It was given by MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal.
India said the objection was fully based on historical facts.
The trade was to resume through Lipulekh Pass in Uttarakhand.
ca17db01fc33c4.x: India said Nepal's objection was NOT based on historical facts and was unilateral.

cac96e07fdd069.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the US executive order “Assuring the Security of the State of Qatar”?
o: It is not legally binding like a treaty.
It cannot be repealed by a future president.
It did not require Senate approval.
It followed Israeli airstrikes in Qatar targeting Hamas leaders.
cac96e07fdd069.x: Being an executive order and not a treaty, it can be repealed by a future president.

ca6cfb8a970117.s: The Gaza Declaration ceasefire of 13 October 2025 was signed by Donald Trump and the guarantor countries at:
ca6cfb8a970117.x: The Gaza Declaration was signed at Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt, with Egypt, Qatar and Turkiye as guarantors; Doha hosted the Afghanistan–Pakistan ceasefire.

ca5769fd5f5b95.s: The US executive order “Assuring the Security of the State of Qatar” was triggered by:
o: Israeli airstrikes in Qatar targeting Hamas leaders
Iran's missile strike on the Al-Udeid base
The reimposition of UNSC snapback sanctions on Iran
ca5769fd5f5b95.x: The order followed Israeli airstrikes in Qatar targeting Hamas leaders about three weeks earlier, which Qatar called “state terror”.

ca5403ba7cd869.s: India's strategic-autonomy approach has its roots in which Nehru-era movement?
ca5403ba7cd869.x: The roots of India's strategic autonomy lie in the Non-Aligned Movement associated with Nehru.

ca257c6774f319.s: Who is Pakistan's army chief referred to in the discussion of India's diplomatic challenges?
ca257c6774f319.x: Pakistan's army chief is Field Marshal Asim Munir.

ca6be626eebb2f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the US tariff on pharmaceutical imports announced in 2025?
o: A 100% tariff applied to branded and patented drug imports from 1 October 2025.
Generic drug imports were also subjected to the 100% tariff.
A firm building a plant in the US could qualify for exemption.
The tariff targeted patented medicines rather than generics.
ca6be626eebb2f.x: Generics were excluded; the 100% tariff applied to branded and patented drugs, with an exemption for firms building a US plant.

caae3b9975a251.s: Under the India–Bhutan cross-border railway projects, the Bhutanese portion is funded through:
o: Bhutan's 13th Five-Year Plan via the Ministry of External Affairs
Bhutan's 12th Five-Year Plan via the Ministry of Railways
caae3b9975a251.x: The Bhutanese portion is funded through Bhutan's 13th Five-Year Plan via the MEA; Special Railway Projects fund the Indian portion.

ca949fb40728c6.s: Under the New Strategic EU–India Agenda, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Security of Information Agreement – India's participation
Trade and Technology Council – Information-security talks
ca949fb40728c6.x: The European Legal Gateway concerns mobility; Horizon Europe involves India's participation, the SoIA information-security talks and the TTC trade and technology.

cad37bf14306c3.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. China reportedly backed India, creating a two-front threat to Pakistan.
2. India treats internationalisation of Kashmir as acceptable rather than a bilateral matter.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad37bf14306c3.x: Both are wrong: China reportedly backed Pakistan, raising a two-front threat for India, and India regards Kashmir as a bilateral matter.

ca521578a2156e.s: The China-backed Teesta River Comprehensive Management and Restoration Project, demanded by protesters in Bangladesh in October 2025, is worth about:
ca521578a2156e.x: Protesters in Chattogram and Rangpur demanded the $1 billion Chinese Teesta project.

cab44008498d92.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 1996 Ganga Water Sharing Treaty expires in 2026.
2. The Teesta originates in Tso Lhamo Lake in Bangladesh.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab44008498d92.x: The Ganga treaty expires in 2026; the Teesta originates in Tso Lhamo Lake in Sikkim, not Bangladesh.

ca97acda3941e1.s:
Consider the following statements about India–Israel economic relations:
1. Annual India–Israel trade is about USD 40 billion.
2. India and Israel were to begin talks on a Free Trade Agreement.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca97acda3941e1.x: Annual trade is about USD 4 billion, not 40 billion; FTA talks were the next step.

n794a33a7657.s: The Non-Aligned Movement, founded in 1961 by Nehru, Tito, Nasser, Nkrumah and Sukarno, was founded at:
n794a33a7657.x: NAM was founded at Belgrade in 1961; non-alignment was not mere neutrality.

ca9488372df663.s: Which of the following Iranian proxy group–country pairs is correctly matched?
ca9488372df663.x: Hezbollah is linked to Lebanon; the Houthis are in Yemen and Hashd al-Shaabi in Iraq.

ca10c4fe54b5c4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. China's Belt and Road Initiative is India's alternative to IMEC.
2. IMEC is presented as India's alternative to China's Belt and Road Initiative.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca10c4fe54b5c4.x: IMEC (India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor) is presented as India's alternative to BRI; statement 1 reverses this.

caefb352ec7725.shape: one-liner (match not buildable: only two dated pairs)
caefb352ec7725.s: The ASEAN–India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) dates to:
caefb352ec7725.x: AITIGA for goods dates to 2010; its services component dates to 2015.

ca8210c1a26f01.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The ASEAN Community Vision 2045 was adopted in June 2025.
2. José Ramos-Horta is the Secretary-General of ASEAN.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8210c1a26f01.x: Both are wrong: the Vision 2045 was adopted in May 2025, and Ramos-Horta is the President of Timor-Leste.

cadf671eb11569.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India reopened tourist visas for Chinese nationals in June 2025.
2. The Panchsheel principles were signed on 29 April 1955.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cadf671eb11569.x: Both are wrong: tourist visas reopened in July 2025, and Panchsheel was signed on 29 April 1954.

ca07e703f82414.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ca07e703f82414.x: The SCO's RATS is located in Tashkent; Bandung was in 1955, the UNGA resolution in 1957, and Panchsheel has five principles.

ca7c1f00e7c52f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The India–Australia Renewable Energy Partnership was launched by Modi and Albanese in 2023.
2. Australian Minister Chris Bowen visited Mumbai in October 2025.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7c1f00e7c52f.x: Both are wrong: the partnership was launched in 2024, and Bowen visited New Delhi, not Mumbai.

cab4f0ca3af997.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The ASEAN Community Vision 2047 was linked with Viksit Bharat 2047.
2. 2026 was declared the Year of ASEAN–India Maritime Cooperation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab4f0ca3af997.x: The ASEAN Community Vision is for 2045 (linked with Viksit Bharat 2047), so 1 is wrong; 2026 is the Year of ASEAN–India Maritime Cooperation.

ca2a376ac8e88a.s: Which of the following India–ASEAN milestone–year pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
ca2a376ac8e88a.x: The summit-level partnership began in 2002, not 2012; the strategic partnership dates to 2012.

cad91ae8700f04.s: What action did the US take on products refined from Russian oil, including those re-exported by India?
cad91ae8700f04.x: The US imposed tariffs on products refined from Russian oil, including those re-exported by India.

ca9724abd9e793.s: Regarding the Trump–Xi Busan summit and US tariffs, which pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: US tariffs on Chinese imports – Cut to 47%
Truce on tariffs and rare-earth export curbs – One year
ca9724abd9e793.x: India faced 50% tariffs (25% retaliatory plus 25% Russia-oil levy); 47% is the cut rate on Chinese imports.

cafdd88dc7132e.s: The installed capacity of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) is:
cafdd88dc7132e.x: GERD has an installed capacity of 5,150 MW, with storage of 74 billion cubic metres.

caeebd46fe6233.s: In the ‘Axis of Upheaval’ discussed around the SCO Summit 2025, CRINK refers to:
o: China, Russia, India and North Korea
Cuba, Russia, Iran and North Korea
China, Russia, Iraq and North Korea
China, Russia, Iran and North Korea
caeebd46fe6233.x: CRINK denotes China, Russia, Iran and North Korea, an informal alignment rather than a formal alliance like NATO.

ca4e3743035065.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India–China air connectivity?
o: Direct flights were suspended from January 2020.
Fewer than 20 weekly flights operated before 2020.
The suspension was linked to COVID-19 and later Galwan tensions.
Direct flights resumed after about five years following the Modi–Xi meeting at Tianjin.
ca4e3743035065.x: Over 80 weekly flights operated between India and China before 2020.

cadc5200e86d91.s:
Consider the following statements about the Trump–Netanyahu Gaza peace plan:
1. The Palestinian Authority's role was unconditional and statehood was clearly defined.
2. Bezalel Smotrich supported the plan while Egypt opposed it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cadc5200e86d91.x: Both are wrong: the PA's role was conditional on reforms with statehood left vague, and Egypt supported the plan while Smotrich opposed it.

ca8cf52e43c5bf.s: Through which organisation will India showcase PM-KUSUM and PM Surya Ghar in Africa and island nations?
ca8cf52e43c5bf.x: India will showcase PM-KUSUM and PM Surya Ghar through the International Solar Alliance.

cad3bc0f880fae.s:
Consider the following statements about the exposition of Lord Buddha's Sacred Relics in Kalmykia:
1. It was held in Elista, the capital of Kalmykia.
2. The venue was the Geden Sheddup Choikorling Monastery, inaugurated in 1996.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad3bc0f880fae.x: Both are correct: the relics were shown in Elista at the Geden Sheddup Choikorling Monastery (“Golden Abode of Shakyamuni Buddha”), inaugurated in 1996.

caaf4697370124.s: In the debate over US tariffs on products refined from Russian oil, India was characterised as:
o: A member of the Western alliance
A leader of an anti-Western bloc
A force for equilibrium between the West and the Global South
A neutral bystander in global trade
caaf4697370124.x: India was viewed as a force for equilibrium between the West and the Global South.

ca4ac0963fee12.s: India's target for non-fossil installed capacity by 2030 is:
ca4ac0963fee12.x: India targets 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030 (including 280 GW of solar) and reached 50% non-fossil installed capacity in July 2025.

ca1a099497464f.s: The Kalmykia exposition recalled which Buddhist figure who revived Buddhism in Mongolia, Kalmykia, Buryatia and Tuva?
ca1a099497464f.x: The 19th Kushok Bakula Rinpoche revived Buddhism in Mongolia, Kalmykia, Buryatia and Tuva.

ca9dddcf7e63ff.s:
Consider the following statements about India's 2025 special economic package for Mauritius:
1. It includes a 500-bed Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam National Hospital.
2. It includes the first Jan Aushadhi Kendra outside India.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9dddcf7e63ff.x: Both are correct: the package announced at Varanasi on 11 September 2025 includes the 500-bed hospital and the first Jan Aushadhi Kendra outside India.

ca074098575eb8.s:
Consider the following statements about the Beijing+30 High-Level Meeting at the UN:
1. It marked the 35th anniversary of the Fourth World Conference on Women.
2. The Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action was adopted in 1996.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca074098575eb8.x: Both are wrong: it marked the 30th anniversary, and the Beijing Declaration dates to 1995.

ca88d97c01a4e3.s: Pakistan, described at the Doha emergency summit as the only nuclear-armed Muslim nation, holds approximately how many warheads?
ca88d97c01a4e3.x: Pakistan was described as the only nuclear-armed Muslim nation, with about 170 warheads.

cab7c017bfacbe.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Turkey preferred military action rather than economic sanctions in response to the Doha strike.
2. India's arms imports from Israel amounted to less than $2 billion a year.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab7c017bfacbe.x: Both are wrong: Turkey preferred economic sanctions, and India–Israel arms imports were over $2 billion a year.

ca07d3b42b6145.s: The Beijing+30 High-Level Meeting on women's rights called for universal ratification of:
o: the Convention on the Rights of the Child
ca07d3b42b6145.x: The Beijing+30 meeting called for universal ratification of CEDAW.

ca805b2c787f57.s: Though officially termed run-of-river, the Sawalkote hydroelectric project's reservoir (over 50,000 crore litres) is considered closer to a:
ca805b2c787f57.x: With a reservoir exceeding 50,000 crore litres, Sawalkote is termed run-of-river but considered closer to a storage project.

cab7fa24ebae55.s: Which of the following diaspora category–legal basis pairs is correctly matched?
cab7fa24ebae55.x: The NRI's legal basis includes the Income Tax Act, 1961 (and FEMA, 1999); the PIO's basis was the PIO Card Scheme, 2002.

ca4f32ab02f4f0.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Nepal was the first country in the WHO South-East Asia Region to adopt a laboratory algorithm for rubella surveillance.
2. The MMR vaccine requires three doses.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4f32ab02f4f0.x: Nepal was the first in the WHO SEA Region to adopt that algorithm; the MMR vaccine has two doses, not three.

cae0f5bf1eed2a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Skilled migration has existed since the 1990s, the US H-1B being an example.
2. GCC countries host mainly temporary labour migrants.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae0f5bf1eed2a.x: Both are correct: skilled migration since the 1990s includes the H-1B route, and GCC countries mainly host temporary labour migrants.

ca146fd4600a5e.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana targets 35 million formal jobs in two years.
2. The India–ILO MoU mandates migration.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca146fd4600a5e.x: The Yojana targets 35 million formal jobs in two years; the India–ILO MoU does not mandate migration.

ca1bd69b71de54.s:
With reference to India's nuclear laws, consider the following statements:
1. The Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act was enacted in 1962.
2. The Atomic Energy Act was enacted in 2010.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca1bd69b71de54.x: Both are wrong: the dates are swapped — the CLND Act is of 2010 and the Atomic Energy Act of 1962.

ca191f4b62338f.s: Regarding the India–Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Indian enclaves in Bangladesh – 51, merged into India
Bangladeshi enclaves in India – 111, transferred to Bangladesh
ca191f4b62338f.x: 922 people from Indian enclaves in Bangladesh migrated to India; 111 Indian enclaves went to Bangladesh, 51 Bangladeshi enclaves merged into India, and 14,854 became new Indian citizens.

caa3c3ade72fa4.s: Which of the following Gaza cultural sites is correctly matched with its historical detail?
o: Church of Saint Porphyrius – Greek Orthodox, 5th century
caa3c3ade72fa4.x: Saint Porphyrius is a 5th-century Greek Orthodox church; the Omari Mosque is 7th century, Al-Qissariya Mamluk and Pasha's Palace a 17th-century Radwan castle.

ca985198ac6eea.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. As the EU's Common Foreign and Security Policy requires unanimity, European states recognised Palestine individually.
2. Norway hosted the Oslo Accords in 1993.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca985198ac6eea.x: Both are correct: CFSP unanimity led to recognition by individual states, and Norway hosted the 1993 Oslo Accords.

ca5204fbca6b19.s: Rubella (German measles) can cause which condition in infants?
ca5204fbca6b19.x: Rubella can cause Congenital Rubella Syndrome, with about 1,00,000 cases globally each year.

cab5a94a13d6e5.s: Since March 2023, an International Criminal Court arrest warrant has been pending against:
cab5a94a13d6e5.x: The ICC arrest warrant against Vladimir Putin has been in force since March 2023.

ca449c6b1f5231.s:
Consider the following statements about Khaled El-Enany:
1. He was nominated as UNESCO Director-General by the UNESCO General Conference.
2. The UNESCO Executive Board nominated him at its 222nd session on 6 October 2025.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca449c6b1f5231.x: The Executive Board, not the General Conference, made the nomination; the final appointment was left to the General Conference in Uzbekistan.

ca308f19ee007d.s: In the context of Khaled El-Enany's nomination for UNESCO Director-General, which pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Édouard Firmin Matoko – Candidate defeated in the Executive Board vote
Khaled El-Enany – Egyptologist and Egypt's Minister of Antiquities (2016–2019)
His possible appointment – First Arab Director-General
United States – Rejoined UNESCO in July 2025
ca308f19ee007d.x: The United States withdrew from UNESCO in July 2025; the other pairs are correct.

cab1d935be1521.s: Who was conferred the title ‘Vishva Vaidya Divyang Bandhu’ by Mauritius PM Ramgoolam at the Mauritius Telugu Maha Sabha's Ugadi celebrations?
cab1d935be1521.x: Dr Guduru Jagadish, former chief of TTD's BIRRD Trust Hospital, received the title.

ca7cd8e5ed9054.s: Dr Guduru Jagadish received the title ‘Vishva Vaidya Divyang Bandhu’ for:
o: Free polio screening and corrective surgery camps
Anaemia eradication campaigns and maternal care
ca7cd8e5ed9054.x: He was recognised for free polio screening and corrective surgery camps; anaemia eradication relates to V. Prasanna Venkatesh.

caee133d0d8ca5.s: The Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc loop completed by Viswabharath Allamsetti was about how long?
caee133d0d8ca5.x: The UTMB is a 176.5 km loop around the Mont Blanc massif; he finished in 44 hours with over 10,000 m of elevation gain.

ca6fc6420c6d4e.s: Where were the World Transplant Games 2025 held?
ca6fc6420c6d4e.x: The World Transplant Games 2025 were held in Dresden, Germany.

ca9cf5fd5c75ca.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Forest Section Officer Nagavasu Naidu Sunkara won gold in the 5 km racewalk at the World Transplant Games 2025.
2. The World Transplant Games are biennial and organised by the World Transplant Games Federation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9cf5fd5c75ca.x: Sunkara won silver, not gold, so 1 is wrong; the Games are biennial and run by the World Transplant Games Federation.

caddacd4113589.s: Which of the following achievements of skater Arun Kumar Rayudu is correctly matched?
o: National roller skating titles – Six-time champion
National ice skating titles – Six-time champion
caddacd4113589.x: Rayudu is a six-time national ice-skating champion; he is a 16-time roller-skating champion, was world U-19 No. 5 in 2017 and is Asia No. 2 among seniors.

caa479d966bef8.s:
Regarding the 12th State-Level Inter-District Women's Kabaddi tournament, consider the following statements:
1. Krishna district women's team won the tournament.
2. Chittoor district women's team was the runner-up.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa479d966bef8.x: Both are correct: Krishna district won and Chittoor was runner-up.

ca01c52ec3a3e0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 8th AP State Wrestling Championship?
o: NTR district was the Under-15 champion.
It was held at Rajamahendravaram on 6 April 2025.
Alluri Sitharama Raju was the Under-20 champion.
ca01c52ec3a3e0.x: Kakinada was the Under-20 champion, with Alluri Sitharama Raju as runner-up.

caeda508a37afa.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2017:
1. Its vision was “Sports for All and Excellence in Sports”, with badminton as a priority sport.
2. It included Khelo Andhra Pradesh and proposed Sports Cities in Amaravati and Visakhapatnam.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caeda508a37afa.x: Both are correct descriptions of the AP Sports Policy 2017.

ne6fda6a6a3a.s: The revenue deficit estimated in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 was:
ne6fda6a6a3a.x: The 2026-27 revenue deficit is ₹22,002 crore, or 1.11% of GSDP; 2.33% is the 2025-26 RE ratio, ₹37,281 crore is interest and ₹75,868 crore the fiscal deficit.

ca722dfa4c188a.s: Which source of AP government's rupee receipts in Budget 2026-27 is correctly matched with its share?
ca722dfa4c188a.x: Open market borrowings are 30%; state taxes 38%, share in central taxes 19% and grants-in-aid 10%.

cac655642e92ca.s: In the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27, the Water Resources Department was allocated:
cac655642e92ca.x: Water Resources got ₹18,224 crore; ₹32,308 crore went to School Education.

ca6fc24258adf3.s:
With reference to Union Budget 2026–27 estimates, consider the following statements:
1. The fiscal deficit for BE 2026–27 is 4.4% of GDP.
2. The debt-to-GDP ratio for BE 2026–27 is 55.6%.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6fc24258adf3.x: The BE 2026–27 fiscal deficit is 4.3% (4.4% is RE 2025–26); the debt-to-GDP ratio is 55.6%.

n453c2b116a0.s: In the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27, Health (about ₹19,306 crore, 5.81% of the Budget) was the ____ largest departmental allocation.
n453c2b116a0.x: Health was the 4th largest allocation; School Education (₹32,308 crore) was the largest.

ca8f6f941ef4c3.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 was the first Budget prepared at:
ca8f6f941ef4c3.x: The Union Budget 2026–27 was the first prepared at Kartavya Bhavan.

ca6be2c9d154d9.s:
Consider the following statements about the NITI Aayog Fiscal Health Index 2023-24:
1. Telangana secured the seventh rank.
2. Andhra Pradesh secured the sixteenth rank.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6be2c9d154d9.x: Telangana ranked seventh; Andhra Pradesh ranked seventeenth, not sixteenth.

ca639604197e8d.s:
Consider the following statements about Union Budget 2026–27:
1. Capital expenditure was raised to ₹11.2 lakh crore.
2. REITs were proposed to recycle private-sector real estate assets.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca639604197e8d.x: Both are wrong: capex was raised to ₹12.2 lakh crore, and REITs were proposed for CPSE real estate assets.

ca649c9dd5b283.s: Union Budget 2026–27 proposed a new dedicated freight corridor from:
ca649c9dd5b283.x: The new dedicated freight corridor runs from Dankuni to Surat; the Budget also proposed 20 new National Waterways over 5 years.

cad4e92353415b.s:
Consider the following statements about Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals:
1. The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme is a one-time, 3-month scheme for small taxpayers.
2. Updated returns are allowed only before reassessment begins.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad4e92353415b.x: Both are wrong: the scheme runs for 6 months, and updated returns are allowed even after reassessment begins, with an additional 10% tax.

ca102873ee8c47.s: Which of the following tax-compliance measures in Union Budget 2026–27 is correctly matched?
o: Decriminalised provisions – Single-window filing through depositories
Form 15G/15H – Rules-based automated process for small taxpayers
ca102873ee8c47.x: Form 15G/15H gets single-window filing through depositories; lower/nil TDS certificates get a rules-based automated process.

ca7c2052d3d5d0.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The first Budget in British India was presented on 26 November 1947 by R.K. Shanmukham Chetty.
2. The first Budget of the Republic was presented by R.K. Shanmukham Chetty.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7c2052d3d5d0.x: Both are wrong: James Wilson presented British India's first Budget on 7 April 1860, Chetty presented independent India's first Budget on 26 November 1947, and John Mathai presented the Republic's first Budget.

ca9b7795d2b7fb.s:
Consider the following statements about the 16th Finance Commission:
1. It was constituted in 2025.
2. Its recommendations cover 2027-28 to 2031-32.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9b7795d2b7fb.x: Both are wrong: it was constituted in 2024 under Arvind Panagariya, and its award covers 2026-27 to 2030-31.

cafbd79ddd6791.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission, which horizontal devolution criterion is correctly matched with its weight?
cafbd79ddd6791.x: Area carries 10% (reduced); income distance has 42.5%, population 17.5% and forest and ecology 10% (retained).

ca4d7ced8542cc.s:
Consider the following statements about the Padma Awards 2026:
1. Techi Gubin of Arunachal Pradesh received the Padma Shri in Social Work.
2. Techi Gubin of Arunachal Pradesh received the Padma Shri in Arts.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4d7ced8542cc.x: Techi Gubin was honoured in Social Work, not Arts.

ca91e29d5530e8.s: Which of the following Padma Shri 2026 awardee–field pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Swami Brahmadev Ji Maharaj – Social Work
ca91e29d5530e8.x: Gafruddeen Mewati Jogi was honoured in Arts, not Social Work.

cabd2b1a01bbcb.s:
Consider the following statements about foreign Padma Shri 2026 awardees:
1. Vladimir Mestvirishvili of Georgia was honoured posthumously in Sports.
2. Prof. Lars Christian Koch is from Germany and Lyudmila Viktorovna Khokhlova from Russia.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?

caabe42a9c10e5.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Dharmendra, a Padma Vibhushan awardee, died in November 2025 at the age of 89.
2. Telugu actor Kota Srinivasa Rao, whose career spanned over 40 years, died on 13 July.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?

cafa896826ad0e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Garimella Balakrishna Prasad?
o: He received the Padma Shri in 2026.
His award was for Literature and Education.
cafa896826ad0e.x: He received the Padma Shri posthumously in Arts, not Literature and Education.

cad690edfb51ae.s: Which of the following Padma Shri 2026 awardee–State pairs is correctly matched?
cad690edfb51ae.x: Naresh Chandra Deb Verma is from Tripura; Halli War is from Meghalaya, Pongenor from Nagaland and Baldev Singh from Punjab.

cac160a0314346.s: The Padma Awards, instituted in 1954, are announced on Republic Day through a notification of the:
cac160a0314346.x: The Padma Awards (instituted 1954) are announced on Republic Day through a Ministry of Home Affairs notification.

ca29620bbc1bda.s: Which of the following Telugu Jnanpith awardee–year pairs is correctly matched?
ca29620bbc1bda.x: Ravuri Bharadwaja received the Jnanpith in 2012; Viswanatha Satyanarayana in 1970 and C. Narayana Reddy in 1988.

ca32ce221a4de4.s: Which of the following Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 language–work pairs is correctly matched?
o: Urdu – Mid Birna Chenne Sawon Inag Sagai
ca32ce221a4de4.x: Animesha (Nandini Sidda Reddy) won in Telugu; Waghu won in Sindhi, Safar Jaari Hai in Urdu and Mid Birna Chenne Sawon Inag Sagai in Santali.

cae6ccf3279d0b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 98th Academy Awards?
o: One Battle After Another won Best Picture.
One Battle After Another was the second-biggest winner with four awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor.
cae6ccf3279d0b.x: One Battle After Another was the biggest winner with six awards; Sinners was second with four.

cab41b62d83361.s: R. Vairamuthu, the 60th Jnanpith awardee, has won the National Film Award for Best Lyricist how many times?
cab41b62d83361.x: Vairamuthu has won the Best Lyricist National Award 7 times; he also received the Padma Shri (2003) and Padma Bhushan (2014).

ca1809887d17fd.s:
Consider the following statements about the 83rd Golden Globe Awards:
1. India received no nomination.
2. Priyanka Chopra Jonas presented an award at the ceremony.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?

ca4c6a8faa0e65.s:
Consider the following statements about the 79th BAFTA Film Awards 2026:
1. Jessie Buckley won Leading Actress.
2. Sean Penn won Leading Actor.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4c6a8faa0e65.x: Jessie Buckley won Leading Actress; Leading Actor went to Robert Aramayo for I Swear, while Sean Penn won a supporting award.

cafe11a1dc8f87.s:
Consider the following statements about the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2026:
1. Lt. Col. Seetha Ashok Shelke of Maharashtra won the Individual category.
2. The award is announced every year on 26 January.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cafe11a1dc8f87.x: Shelke won the Individual category; the award is announced on 23 January (Parakram Diwas), not 26 January.

ca946bb24d8b49.s:
Consider the following statements about India at the Academy Awards:
1. Mother India (1958) was India's first nominated film.
2. Bhanu Athaiya became the first Indian winner, for Costume Design in Gandhi (1983).
3. Bhanu Athaiya received an honorary Oscar in 1992.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca946bb24d8b49.x: Mother India was first nominated in 1958 and Bhanu Athaiya won in 1983 for Gandhi; the 1992 honorary Oscar went to Satyajit Ray.

ca88849a1fd359.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bhoj Wetlands was designated a Ramsar site in 2022.
2. Sirpur Wetland was designated a Ramsar site in 2022.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca88849a1fd359.x: Bhoj Wetlands was designated in 2002, not 2022; Sirpur Wetland was designated in 2022.

ca5896995af2d7.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary, added on 22 April 2026, took India's Ramsar total to 98.
2. Surha Tal (Jayaprakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary), added in June 2026, took the total to 99.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5896995af2d7.x: Both are wrong: Shekha Jheel took the total to 99 and Surha Tal to 100.

ca6c75406d7af5.s: Which of the following Rajasthan Ramsar site–year pairs is correctly matched?
ca6c75406d7af5.x: Menar Wetland Complex was designated in 2025; Keoladeo in 1981, Sambhar in 1990 and Khichan in 2025.

ca7e65f82dbd73.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. East Calcutta Wetlands was designated a Ramsar site in 2019.
2. Sundarbans Wetland was designated a Ramsar site in 2002.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7e65f82dbd73.x: Both are wrong: the years are swapped — East Calcutta Wetlands in 2002 and Sundarbans in 2019.

ca80eb74c55754.s:
Consider the following statements about State-wise Ramsar sites:
1. Uttar Pradesh has 13 Ramsar sites.
2. Rajasthan has 6 Ramsar sites.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca80eb74c55754.x: Uttar Pradesh has 13; Rajasthan has 5 (6 is the count for Odisha and Punjab).

ca4aa261ac7c42.s: Which of the following Ramsar site–State pairs is correctly matched?
ca4aa261ac7c42.x: Pala Wetland is in Mizoram; Loktak is in Manipur, Rudrasagar in Tripura and Khecheopalri in Sikkim.

cab213deba5c40.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Reserve was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
2. Vembannur Wetland Complex was designated a Ramsar site in 2024.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cab213deba5c40.x: Both are wrong: both sites were designated in 2022.
